name: InterContinental Danang Sun Peninsula Resort
positioning: Beach resort on a secluded private bay of the Son Tra Peninsula, spread from forested hills down to a sandy beach, with Modern Vietnamese rooms, penthouses and villas with private pools, and rainforest walks and wildlife expeditions
best_for: Couples and families who want a secluded beach resort near Da Nang
Guests who want a villa or penthouse with a private pool
Travelers who enjoy nature walks and wildlife in the surrounding forest

facts.text: The resort overlooks a secluded bay on the Son Tra Peninsula.
The resort is spread across the lush hills of the Son Tra Peninsula nature reserve, down to the sandy shores of the East Sea.
The resort's private beach leads to the clear waters of a sheltered bay.
Rooms are decorated in a Modern Vietnamese style, with spindled wooden pillars that evoke traditional temple architecture.
Room interiors have Vietnamese-inspired decor and open onto spacious balconies with ocean views.
The Club Penthouse and Villa Collection has expansive indoor and outdoor spaces and private pools.
The forests around the resort are home to unique flora and fauna.
Guests can take jungle walks or join the resort's nature expert on a Wildlife Expedition.
The resort has an 800-year-old banyan tree.
Citron has open-air dining booths shaped like traditional non la hats.
The resort has the Planet Trekkers kids' club.
Hoi An, a UNESCO Heritage Site, is about a 40-minute drive from the resort.
